#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    vector<int> a(51, 0);
    int n = 0;
    do {
        a[++n] = m % w;
        m /= w;
    } while (m > 0);

    bool ok = true;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ) {
        if (a[i] > 1) {
            a[i] += 1;
            if (a[i] == w) {
                while (i <= n && a[i] >= w) {
                    a[i] = 0;
                    a[++i] += 1;
                }
            } else {
                ++i;
            }
            if (a[i-1] > 1) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        } else {
            ++i;
        }
    }
    if (ok) cout << "YES" << endl;
    else cout << "NO" << endl;
    return 0;
}
